scope: Primary-source evidence for a small pottery-relevant fracture benchmark. This record does not assert calibration of PG-Frag material parameters.

sources.citation: N. S. Müller, G. Vekinis, P. M. Day, V. Kilikoglou, The influence of microstructure and texture on the mechanical properties of rock tempered archaeological ceramics, Journal of the European Ceramic Society 35 (2015), 831-843.
sources.source_limit: Controlled experimental briquettes made from pottery clays; not excavated sherds. The paper does not publish raw digitized curves or full support-span dimensions.

sources.citation: V. Kilikoglou, G. Vekinis, Y. Maniatis, P. M. Day, Mechanical performance of quartz-tempered ceramics: Part I, strength and toughness, Archaeometry 40(2) (1998), 261-279.

visual_evidence.recipe: 20 vol% quartz temper, mean grain size 450 um; the paper describes a step-like four-point-bend fracture surface.
visual_evidence.scale: No calibrated scale is given in the caption; no digitized crack path is provided.
visual_evidence.qualification: Qualitative surface morphology only. Do not combine this recipe with the 2015 Kalami material card.

candidate_material_condition.material_class: experimental low-calcareous pottery clay ceramic; highly vitrified high-fire condition
candidate_material_condition.archaeological_or_engineering_status: Experimental pottery-relevant briquette, not excavated archaeological pottery and not dense engineering ceramic

material.clay_particle_fraction: <30 um fraction separated from raw clay
material.drying: over 10 days at ambient conditions under plaster plates
material.porosity_note: Mostly closed for untempered high-fired material; figure-derived rounded value. Paper states the high-fired untempered total porosity is comparatively low, about 11%.

true_density_g_cm3_estimate.status: Reported approximate true density from constituent mineral phases for raw Kalami material; not measured fired bulk density.

material.bulk_density_status: MISSING as a measured fired-condition value

youngs_modulus_gpa.method: Bending modulus, compliance-corrected; mean of five independent load-displacement determinations

properties.strength_qualification: Approximate source-text value for untempered low-calcareous clay fired at 1050 C. Flaw-sensitive three-point-bend TRS, not intrinsic tensile strength.
properties.k_ic_qualification: Approximate effective stress-intensity factor reported for highest-fired low-calcareous untempered brittle specimens; not independently verified plane-strain ASTM K_IC.

g_ic_eff_j_m2.status: DERIVED_FROM_REPORTED_VALUES; not quoted as an independently measured work-of-fracture value
g_ic_eff_j_m2.plane_strain_numeric_status: MISSING because Poisson ratio is unreported; the source also does not establish a plane-strain size-validity condition.

stable_growth_energy_g_t_j_m2.status: No stable-growth tail reported for selected brittle untempered condition; method reserves G_t for stable post-initiation growth. This is not an independent measured zero for total fracture energy.

test_geometry_and_loading.fracture_test: four-point bending of a pre-notched beam (SENB-style specimen)
test_geometry_and_loading.k_evaluated_at: maximum load / fracture point, with finite-notch-width correction
test_geometry_and_loading.raw_load_displacement_curves: Recorded for specimens according to methods, but per-specimen point series are not published in the article.

fracture_images.status: MISSING; no digitized crack path, shard set, or measured fracture-process-zone image for the selected untempered condition found
fracture_images.related_microstructure: 2015 Figure 2 shows SEM matrix microstructure by firing temperature; it is not a calibrated crack-path dataset.

same_study_alternate_condition_not_to_me.qualification: Potential lower-fire elastic/porosity comparator, but condition-matched numeric fracture toughness is unavailable in the article text/table. Do not transfer the 1050 C value.

minimal_local_comparison.name: high-fired Kalami untempered brittle notched-beam initiation check
minimal_local_comparison.loading_target: Four-point bending; exact support spans unavailable
minimal_local_comparison.allowed_comparison: Scalar initiation/energy-scale check; approximate geometry-informed case only unless support spans and original curves are recovered.
not_supported: validated 3-D shard topology or crack trajectory
direct calibration of a general pottery material card
inference of a physical process-zone size or peridynamic horizon delta
minimal_local_comparison.delta_note: No process-zone length or delta-to-material relation is reported. Do not set delta to fit this energy or notch dimension.

qualification_summary: No fully complete self-consistent material dataset with density, E, nu, strength, fracture energy, complete fixture geometry, and scaled crack imagery was found in the focused primary-source search.

The 2015 Kalami series is the strongest single-study partial candidate because material preparation, firing, porosity, E, strength, fracture toughness method, notch and test speed are connected within one experimental programme.
Keep the lower-fire 850 C condition and high-fire 1050 C condition separate; values change substantially with firing.
Do not combine the 1998 quartz-tempered SEM image or properties with the 2015 Kalami untempered numeric condition.
